name: skyborne
objective: Horde or Alliance Skyborne? Source: Blizzard.
pages: Elves also called shen'dorei, the "hidden people".
Zephras Isle, a brand new zone for levels 1-12.
Windshapers join the Horde, the High Order joins the Alliance.
Needs a Skyborne Heroic Pack or higher. Not included in a normal subscription.
New druid forms made just for the Skyborne.
Glide downward through the air for 10 seconds.
Passive: +1% melee, ranged and spell Haste.
Horde Skysight: +10% run speed. Alliance Read Ley Line: activate a ley line for +100% health and mana regen.
Highborne exiles made a pact with wind spirits and built a civilization in Skywall.
The wind spirits that protected it have vanished, its structures are failing, and the Skyborne are divided.
Descended from the first shen'dorei given the wind spirits' gift of skysight.
Descended from the Highborne scholars of Eldre'Thalas.
